summary: A senator has committed to prioritizing D.C. statehood, while advocacy groups have marked the anniversary of a federal deployment to the District by arguing that statehood remains urgent. Separately, landlords are pressing the D.C. Council on local eviction policy. Without statehood, the District's National Guard answers to the President, not to the officials D.C. residents elect.

articles.title: D.C. Landlords Push the Council to Allow Speedier Evictions
